ac:layout-cell.p: Solution summary · API reuse assessment · API examples — 041

This view preserves SPEC009 and its LCS/SPFE/AXII meanings. LCS-R14 and LCS-A26/27 cover the supplied transition-outcome rule. Release scope, authority, full/partial payment and historical routes are unchanged. These drafts do not enable customer actions.

Engineering entry point. This file owns the required behaviour and functional acceptance. Start with scenarios, then requirements, Annex II rules and acceptance. Use SPEC041 for exact documented contracts and proposed Spain fields; use SPEC030's decision register for reuse, build evidence and unresolved decisions. The business summary explains customer outcomes and delivery choices.

Readiness: suitable for engineering review and implementation planning. Open source interpretations, API/action bindings and actual build coverage still need the named decisions and evidence. Confirmed source facts, proposed design and unqualified behaviour retain their existing labels; examples and mapping inventories do not prove execution.

Show the buyer, seller or authorised accountant the invoice facts, action results and outstanding reports. A transition attempt requests a status change. Its result is separate from the invoice’s last successful status and every external report. Use the glossary. INT-LCS05; REF-PRODUCT.

Before a command or report, check the caller, represented business, actor role and invoice action. Reuse onboarding’s dataset/platform binding and credential references where qualified. A token or connection does not grant business authority. SPFE-S02 Article 11; LCS-R04.

blockquote.p: PROPOSED (Solution Design: Samu Coco / Jiaxin He, 18 Nov 2026) — Scope extension: drafts and delivery notes are not e-invoices. Apply invoice lifecycle states only after issuance; preparation progress remains separate. Issued invoice content is immutable. Technical rejection and external admission remain distinct from ERP issuance, as identified in the SPEC-SEI-023 proposed eligibility boundary. SD-CANCEL01 C-4/P-2.

ac:layout-cell.p: Review and take action continues from Select and open invoice in the SPEC026 detailed retrieval process. Download is a separate choice. The customer or authorised accountant selects a permitted invoice action in the ERP. The ERP submits the action to the Domain Service using the same business and invoice identity, then shows its attempt result and each communication result separately. §4.1 owns the SPFE state meanings and draft platform mapping; SPEC041 §1.2 owns exact documented command UUIDs and required fields. Apply LCS-R04/12–14 before offering or sending an action. These links do not enable unqualified Spain commands.

Create no decision or transition. Keep the current status and any existing obligations visible; deferral does not remove an applicable duty.
Keep actor, dates, amounts and evidence. Assess full payment and each report separately; partial/bank evidence cannot prove public full payment.
Show its attempt result separately. Failure retains the previous successful status and corrective action.
One owner/result per destination. Keep known successes; check the original uncertain attempt before repeating.
Preserve cancellation/replacement history. Uncertain cancellation blocks replacement; it does not withdraw the invoice.
Read saved history. Query the platform separately for evidence Sage has not received.
Preserve chronology and original route. Hold unsafe changes; a new route does not rebind old reports.
Check enabled scope, direction, actor and fields. Keep valid incoming evidence even when its outgoing command is disabled.

ac:layout-cell.p: Invoice-submission withdrawal (CancelInvoice) belongs to SPEC-SEI-023 OUT-SPFE-R02. Use that rule for the issuer action, its boundary outside Article 10 statuses and its linked-instance safeguards; SPEC-SEI-024 §2.4 assesses execution. FP-SEI-002 retains the contract and Compliance questions. This lifecycle view owns cancellation of the earlier business report; that action preserves the invoice and business fact.

ac:layout-cell.p: LCS-I01–09 retain immutable sources, independent results, evidence limits, correction history and separate obligations. Apply business/tenant/environment/delegate checks to reads, writes, subscriptions and support. Protect payment evidence and credentials; monitor stale/unknown facts, deadlines, conflicts and uncertain reports. Targets/retention remain open.
ac:layout-cell.h3: 4.1 SPFE lifecycle states and draft platform mapping
ac:layout-cell.p: This section owns the business meanings and reporting classification. Labels describe the documented meaning; they do not create API statuses. §5.1 owns destination, timing and exception details. §5.2 owns exact external codes and fields. Keep technical codes and UUIDs in the source catalogue and SPEC041 API reference.

blockquote.p: Ownership extension: Lifecycle owns the resulting cancelled state and the business triggers that change action availability. Sending owns the cancellation request, response and recovery. This proposed product-state table adds no Article 10 report type. SPEC-SEI-023 proposed eligibility owns the combined state and reason conditions. SD-CANCEL01 P-1/P-2.

tr.th: Meaning, action availability and safe next step

tr.td: Record full commercial rejection. Offer cancellation only when the operation did not take place and the state condition is met. If the operation took place and fiscal content is wrong, use a rectifying invoice. Nestor's "Reject -> Cancel" choice is valid only for a nonexistent operation. Rejection alone does not set cancelled; Sending records the issuer request and evidenced response. SD-CANCEL01 C-1/C-5/P-1/P-2; SPFE-S02 Articles 3.5/5.5.
A valid final commercial state when no agreement is reached. Offer a rectifying invoice without requiring it; do not offer cancellation. Keep the partial decision and history. SD-CANCEL01 C-5/P-2.
Accepted explicitly or by silence after four days

Acceptance removes cancellation eligibility. For acceptance by silence, Lifecycle derives and labels that outcome, then notifies the issuer that cancellation is no longer available. Preserve the distinction from an explicit buyer decision and any reporting result. SD-CANCEL01 P-2/P-3.

Final, evidenced outcome of issuer cancellation: AEAT retains as cancelled the document SPFE holds for that invoice: the original when the original passed through SPFE (direct submission, or a private platform submitting the original through SPFE), or the faithful copy when the original was exchanged only through private platforms. Keep the fiscal number associated with that invoice, consumed forever. Do not permit another cancellation, rectification or reactivation. Retain history and distinguish the Phase 2 public-copy outcome from any private-original outcome. SD-CANCEL01 C-2/P-1/P-2.

blockquote.p: PROPOSED (Solution Design: Samu Coco / Jiaxin He, 18 Nov 2026) - Verification pending: "four days" for acceptance by silence is Solution Design input from the 16 November 2026 workshop, Xavier's slides. Verify it against SPFE-S02 Article 7, including the start event and calendar. The recorded source review establishes no four-day acceptance timer; do not substitute the separate reporting deadline. Keep the proposed derived outcome and issuer notification pending that verification. SD-CANCEL01 P-2/P-3.

PROPOSED (Solution Design: Samu Coco / Jiaxin He, 18 Nov 2026) — Independent rectification lifecycle: use the SPEC-SEI-015 modify extension for creation and linkage. The rectifying invoice's decisions and payments are its own; its rejection cannot overwrite the earlier invoice's outcome or reopen a cancelled invoice. SD-CANCEL01 C-1/C-2/P-4.

PROPOSED (Solution Design: Samu Coco / Jiaxin He, 18 Nov 2026) — Qualification boundary: reuse source history, separate views and action-result recovery patterns. Bind eligibility, finality and acceptance-by-silence rules to Spain; preserve France and other-country behaviour. API status values, private-provider support, notification delivery and actual build coverage remain unqualified; no new external status code is assigned here. SD-CANCEL01 P-1–P-4; LIF-G03/04/07/08.

ac:layout-cell.h4: 4.1.1 SPFE lifecycle states and reporting actions — documented baseline
ac:layout-cell.p: The table covers all eight reporting actions in the reviewed Annex II, plus presumed acceptance. A cancellation is an action on an earlier communication, not another payment or commercial state. Mandatory applies only when the reporting duty is effective for the business and invoice. Conditional correction identifies a correction path for an earlier report, not a routine report for every invoice. SPFE-S02 Articles 7–8 and Annex II; ES-RD10 Article 12; SPFE-S22.

tr.td: Acceptance is presumed in the absence of rejection or a later rectifying invoice, under the applicable rule.
No separate acceptance report. Preserve the distinction from explicit buyer approval.
Mandatory when the recipient reporting duty applies; the qualifying prepaid-invoice exception is in §5.1.
Recipient reports rejection with the required date and reason.
Mandatory when rejection occurs and the recipient reporting duty applies.
Optional. Customer action requires enabled product scope.
SPFE-S02 Article 7.2; Annex II I.3; LCS-R12/13
Optional. Customer action requires enabled product scope.
SPFE-S02 Article 7.2; Annex II I.4; LCS-R12/13

ac:layout-cell.p: Completeness here concerns the reviewed business-reporting set, not every possible query state, validation error or transport result. Services 07 — CustomerInvoiceEvents and 08 — SupplierInvoiceEvents report recipient and issuer actions respectively. Services 03–04 consult invoice information and states; services 05–06 retrieve files; service 09 performs PRE validation. SPEC011's operation bindings and response matrix distinguish their results. Invoice withdrawal remains with SPEC023 OUT-SPFE-R02. SPFE-S03 §§6.4–6.10; SPFE-S02 Articles 3.5/5.5/10.
ac:layout-cell.h4: 4.1.2 Draft mapping to existing platform lifecycle
ac:layout-cell.p: Draft — not an approved API mapping or evidence of Spain implementation. Existing platform names and actor meanings come from INT-LCS03/04; the Spain relationships below are proposed analysis. Qualified incoming evidence may be retained even when the matching outgoing action is unavailable. LCS-R13.

Journey use assumes an ordinary seller-issued invoice. Sent and received are relative to the represented business. In self-billing or delegated cases, apply the actual actor role and action authority; invoice direction does not grant authority. Use the glossary's sending, receiving and invoice roles. Viewing evidence and performing actions both require qualified support.

ac:layout-cell.p: SPEC041 §2.1 owns the three conditional reuses, five missing action bindings and exact technical identifiers. The numeric catalogue value is not the UUID accepted by POST statusCode.

operationStatus describes a transition attempt: IN_PROGRESS means underway, COMPLETED means successful and ERROR means failed. Under LCS-R14, failure retains the latest successful invoice status. Operational COMPLETED differs from lifecycle Completed and each external report's result. INT-LCS05; LCS-A26/27.
SPFE applicability remains unconfirmed. The API owner must resolve transition and actor conflicts under LIF-G03 before applying a transition model.
External restrictions and proposed shared controls have separate authority below. §5.2 retains exact action codes and fields.

Payment and rejection cannot be active together for the same invoice.
Cancel the earlier payment communication before sending a changed replacement.
Cancel the earlier rejection communication before sending a changed replacement.
Report full collection; partial collection cannot generate this report.
Collection and non-payment cannot be active together for the same invoice.

Do not mix recipient and issuer actions in one ApplicationResponse.
Check actor authority, required information and enabled scope before reporting. Optional customer actions require Product approval.

ac:layout-cell.p: The §4.1.1 baseline owns mandatory, optional and correction classifications. This section adds destinations, applicability and exceptions. Duties depend on the invoice, actor and effective customer group. LCS-R12/13; ES-RD10 Articles 10/12; SPFE-S02 Article 7.

ac:layout-cell.p: The existing destination table retains exact applicability, separate issuer/public calendars and special correction cases. Optional actions remain disabled until Product approves them.

For the prepaid exception, the invoice or faithful copy must include a payment date before or on the issue date and equal to the operation or tax-point date, as Article 7.4 requires. The exception does not apply when the recipient expressly communicates payment status. Apply the effective customer-group calendar and qualifying public-platform outage procedure retained in the linked destination table. No revised rollout or deadline follows from this reorganisation. SPFE-S02 Articles 7.4/8.4; LCS-SPFE-R04.

Every event references the invoice’s series/number, issue date, seller NIF and seller name. The seller is not automatically the caller or represented reporting actor. ResponseCode uses ApplicationResponse/cac:DocumentResponse/cac:Response/cbc:ResponseCode. SPFE-S02 Annex II; SPFE-S22.

tr.td: Full effective payment; EffectiveDate and DueDate required. Shipment/receipt dates and correction/negative indicators are conditional.

Cancel earlier rejection; do not manufacture explicit acceptance.

ac:layout-cell.p: Cancellation retains the four invoice-reference fields and links to the earlier report. Apply §4.3's cancellation and recovery rules. LCS-SPFE-R01–04/A01–04 and the 52-row AXII matrix retain exact paths, cardinalities and positive/negative checks. The comparison found no material field change; it does not qualify XML generation.

SPFE-S27 adds 28 numbered rules: five general, eight payment, five rejection, five collection and five non-payment rules. The rule review within the existing mapping retains every original cell and source locator, its English meaning, related actions/field rows, validation context and acceptance. It also retains the cancellation conditions in §1 p. 3. The PDF is version 0.1, dated 19 November 2026, marked Borrador; the final BOE remains the legal source. This review adds no action, UUID or report amount.

tr.th: Actor, condition, required behaviour and safe next action

tr.td: Before an enabled Annex II message is sent, verify the referenced invoice's qualified SPFE presence, exact identity, authorised reporting party and event/service match. Keep recipient identity separate from the seller NIF in the invoice reference and from the authenticated caller. Check earlier reports for duplicates and incompatible actions. If presence, authority or original outcome is unknown, hold the report for an owned check; do not infer absence, issue a fresh report or fabricate an invoice state.
S27 §1/§2.1 p. 3, BR-ANEXOII-1–5; S02 Annex II; proposed recovery control LCS-R04/06/07.
LCS-SPFE-R06 Apply qualified event fields and date conditions

For the selected report family, evaluate the conditions below against saved invoice facts and actual dispatch context. Preserve the event's business date and the distinct issue/due/receipt dates. A missing required fact returns a correction action; an unresolved source predicate or failed check holds the affected report as undetermined. Keep the authorised payment/decision fact and earlier successful status while reporting is held.

A cancellation retains all four invoice-reference fields and the correlation to the earlier report. Verify that the invoice exists in SPFE and has not been cancelled, using qualified evidence. A local originalReportId cannot replace invoice references or prove this condition. Reconcile an uncertain cancellation before sending a replacement. Preserve the invoice and original business fact; this action cancels a report, not the invoice.
S27 §1 p. 3; S02 Annex II; proposed correlation/recovery controls LCS-R03/06/07.

Effective payment date and due date are required. Effective date must be on/before SPFE dispatch date. If invoice receipt date is present, it must be on/after issue date. Preserve the four invoice references and the selected group. The two indicator/type checks and the negative-amount eligibility check need the decisions below.

Rejection date and final L1 reason are required; retain string reasons 01/02. Date must be on/before dispatch date. The draft's strictly-after issue-date boundary remains disputed. Preserve the referenced group and four invoice facts.

Collection date is required and must be on/before dispatch date. If invoice receipt date is present, it must be on/after issue date. Preserve the referenced group/facts. The negative-amount operand remains disputed. Payment's mandatory due date does not become mandatory here.

The required date is the payment due date, not an observation or API timestamp. It must be on/before dispatch date. If invoice receipt date is present, it must be on/after issue date. Preserve the referenced group/facts; the negative-amount operand remains disputed.

ac:layout-cell.p: Keep these qualification decisions open under SPFE-Q16/Q21 and LIF-G04/06:

ul.li: BR-PAGO-8/COBRO-5/IMPAGO-5 call BT-113 “Total a pagar”. Final Annex I and the BT list distinguish prepaid amount BT-113 from payable amount BT-115. Confirm the intended operand and interaction with the final negative corrective-invoice indicator. Do not invent a public report amount or reject negative invoices globally.
BR-RECHAZO-3 requires rejection strictly after issue date; S28 ACTION-09 includes same-day wording. Test both boundaries after the governing rule is confirmed; choose neither as a silent default.

BR-PAGO-5/6 constrain the type when their respective indicator is included. Qualify their relation to CorrectedInvoice and NegativeAmountInvoice, and the XML presence/value representation. A proposed boolean false is not proven to mean absence. Preserve existing input names and the corrected/corrective distinction.

Qualify the dispatch-date calendar/timezone, invoice-presence evidence and duplicate/compatibility scope. Recheck eligible work before dispatch without changing event dates during recovery. The source supplies no new lookup endpoint, complete transition matrix or replay guarantee.

ac:layout-cell.p: S27 §1 excludes fixed-mapping, list, NIF and UBL-schema checks; those layers remain part of the selected profile. SPEC011 business and technical error mapping owns response interpretation. A similar rule number cannot assign an error key, HTTP status, retry policy or lifecycle transition. Keep Spain rules separate from France and other countries; existing DTS is the preferred transformation candidate, subject to actual build, contracts, mapping/rules and operations evidence in SPEC030.
Literal UBL-path conflicts and optional indicator semantics remain LIF-G04/SPFE-Q16/17 gates. Do not silently repair source paths or map France reason codes to Spain ConditionCode. SPFE-S08/S22.

Source freshness gate: web review on 13 November 2026 identified catalogue 0.1.5 dated 3 November 2026 and formats 0.1.2 dated 20 October 2026. The registered SPFE-S03/S08 originals remain 0.1.0. Public Platform Integration and Lifecycle owners must preserve and register the newer files, compare affected contracts and rules, and update the evidence register before declaring this specification current. The tables use the reviewed business-reporting baseline; WSDL currency and runtime coverage remain separate qualification questions. REF-SPFE-WEB; RES-SEI-002 release review.

Shared behaviour preserves evidence, independent views and safe recovery. Spain rules supply actors, events, fields, duties and calendars. Prefer existing DTS for required ApplicationResponse mapping, subject to build/mapping/operations proof. Another country keeps its own rules; saved history keeps its original versions. LCS-A13/14; LIF-API-A01/04/08.

blockquote.p: PROPOSED (Solution Design: Samu Coco / Jiaxin He, 18 Nov 2026) - Extensions to LCS-A03/05/18/26/27: full rejection offers cancellation only if the operation did not take place; if it took place and fiscal content is wrong, offer rectification. Partial rejection can remain final without rectification. Explicit or four-day silent acceptance removes cancellation; notify the issuer of silent acceptance and label it derived. Verify the four-day workshop input, start event and calendar against SPFE-S02 Article 7. SD-CANCEL01 P-1/P-2/P-3.

PROPOSED (Solution Design: Samu Coco / Jiaxin He, 18 Nov 2026) — Extensions to LCS-A06/07/13/14/24: verify the cancellation response and final original/copy result separately from request acceptance, technical failure, private outcomes and report cancellation. Keep cancelled final under late/repeated events and refuse number reuse, rectification and reactivation. Exercise an independently accepted/rejected/paid rectifying invoice, and ensure Spain proposals do not alter another country's history or action rules. These are proposed checks, not completed tests. SD-CANCEL01 C-2/P-4.

Cover all eight reporting actions and the separate presumed-acceptance view in §4.1.1. Retain actors, dates/reasons, uncertain cancellations and rollout/prepaid/outage conditions under §§4.3/5.1/5.2. SPFE-S02/S03/S22.
All 52 field/group occurrences retain valid/applicable and invalid-content checks. REF-FIELDS.

Pending then failed transition retains the last successful status; history records operationStatus = ERROR, correlation and next action. Report failure cannot erase a saved business fact. R03/06/08/14; INT-LCS05.
Distinguish lifecycle Completed (209), operational COMPLETED, ERROR and an unknown external result. None alone creates payment, acceptance or public admission. R02/03/07/14; INT-LCS03/05.

For all eight actions, test saved seller/buyer identity, represented party, caller authority, SPFE presence and event/service match. Test wrong/missing/unknown evidence and a withdrawn invoice. Preserve authorised facts and hold the report with an owner; no invented lookup operation or inference of invoice absence. R05/R07; S27 §1/§2.1.

Exercise all four report families with required/optional fields, exact string reasons, and before/equal/after date boundaries. Distinguish dispatch, issue, event, receipt and due dates. DEFAULT uses due date; PAYMENT's required due date cannot leak to SETTLEMENT. Original event dates survive delayed attempts. R06; S27 §§2.2–2.5.

Exercise BT-113/115, zero/positive/negative amounts, standard/384/471 invoice types and absent/present indicators. Keep disputed amount/date/indicator predicates undetermined until qualified; no silent choice, boolean-presence inference or global negative-invoice rejection. R06; SPFE-Q16/Q21.

Test repeated, incompatible and outcome-unknown reports; cancellation with complete references versus originalReportId alone; and replacement after an uncertain cancellation. Preserve invoice/fact/history and prior successes. No duplicate-effect or replay guarantee follows from the duplicate-message rule. R05/R07; S27 §1/§2.1; LCS-R06/07.

Account for every numbered source rule and all 52 existing field occurrences. Missing packs/evaluation failures cannot produce a successful eligibility result. Bind source/schema/rule versions and prove France/Spain isolation. New draft rules do not enable optional scope, add an API UUID or define a four-day acceptance timer. R05–07; LCS-R12/13; LIF-G04/08.
